title: The Shocking Truth About Budgeting

scenes.fact: Only 32% of Americans maintain a budget successfully.
scenes.text: Over 60% of people fail at budgeting!
People often underestimate their expenses by 25%.
But small changes can lead to big results!
Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Budgeting can feel impossible for many. Learn the surprising truth behind budgeting failures and the simple changes that can help. Follow for more insights!
